why: Searches found ℵ_ω is still described as the least possible Jónsson cardinal with the consistency of it being Jónsson (i.e., admitting no Jónsson algebra) relative to large cardinals still open; a March 2025 paper on Jónsson and Magidor filters addresses the related but distinct ω-Magidor property under AD, not this problem.
queries: "aleph_omega" Jónsson cardinal open problem resolved proof
